title: eat shit & die 218
author: bpatrick
body: Summer of Comics comes to end with some Onan. I start school tomorrow and while I plan to maintain a good updating schedule, school has a way of taking over.

comments.author: randomjackass
comments.text:
Good summer of comics. Thanks for all the updates.

Why doesn’t Onan have it’s own ‘section’ it’s under the ES&D banner ?

comments.author: Ed Dale
comments.text: Onan always leaves me thinking I should have got a degree in art symbolism and metaphor.

comments.author: D
comments.text: Whoa do I see a girl with a flat chest? Has got to be a first for akimbo!

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text:
I wouldn’t say flat; she probably keeps them well hidden in that suit. I like where Onan is going. And by that I mean, I still don’t know where it’s going and hope never to.

I think the popular demand for an Onan section is something the akimbocomics team can handle. Until then, here’s most of the Onan series (I purposefully left out the original 3 since they are special to me and I want the true Onan fans to have to look for them).

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text: Is the Onan tag not easy to use? Thanks for posting these Jonny but the Onan tag should make them easy to find.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: Well I’ll be… Always just looked under categories. Just didn’t realize how the Tags worked with such names as breasts and sex being links I never click in fear of Internet viruses.

comments.author: Gogo Yubari
comments.text:
The problem with the tag system is that you can’t read through a series all at once— when you hit “next” or “previous” at the bottom of a page that you reached through a tag you’ll just go to the next comic in that section of the site, which for Onan is es&d. So then you have to go back and click the next one and it’s not as easy to just read through them as it is for the other stories.

If it’s not too much work to put them in the “categories” section it seems like it’s just generally a better system.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: I was reminded that school is in full swing now and thought of you b. How are your courses/seminars/whatever-it-is-you-take-as-a-masters treating you? And what is it you are taking this time anyway?

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text: Thanks, Jonny Paycheck. I’m in my second year of medical school. It’s going OK. No time to make comics which makes me sad and crazy. But it’s good. Thanks for asking. I’ve got a test next week and then I’ll have a minute to breath and make some comics. Look for an update next weekend.

comments.author: randomjackass
comments.text: Are we going to see any medical drama comics ? Dr. House meets Onan ? What is medical school even like? I picture lots of carving up of dead bodies, but that’s because my only exposure to med school was a viewing of The Reanimator many years ago.
